dimensions.supplement_source: Each received supplement retains its actual source ID and is applied once at its recorded native request. Unadopted material grants no instruction.
dimensions.queue_order: Actual starts match the saved queue in order; partial failure never changes the following goal, scope or approval.
dimensions.parallel_isolation: One real Main owns different conversation records and Task IDs; native inputs, actions, approval and actual local recipients remain separate.
dimensions.stop_effect: An accepted per-task stop forbids new sends and actions for that task and its child/review scope; existing partial effects and unresolved cost remain recorded.
dimensions.honest_state: Saved, started, applied, sent and stopped states have corresponding public and original evidence.
dimensions.content_review: Fixed model replies measure program facts only; named human review and user acceptance remain separate.
